identity.name: Icicle Rosary
identity.summary: A loop of white ice beads hanging from a long silver spike.
identity.description: Costs 2 mana per activation. Deals 6 magical damage per affordable activation. Reduces each enemy strike this round by 2.
identity.lore: Each bead holds one silent breath of a lost pilgrim.

effects.description: Costs 2 mana per activation. Deals 6 magical damage per affordable activation. Reduces each enemy strike this round by 2.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its frost trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Grave Bandage, Rime Thimble into Icicle Rosary.

visual.brief: A loop of white ice beads hanging from a long silver spike.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
definingFeatures: A loop of white ice beads hanging from a long silver spike.
